title: Add throttled code-search query timing telemetry
description: Add operator-visible code-search query telemetry that is explicitly disableable and sampled to avoid introducing measurable request overhead in normal operation. Capture cache/vector/lexical mode, elapsed time, and result count with sampled debug logs plus slow-query warning escalation so throughput regressions are diagnosable without forcing always-on tracing.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed in `MemorySmith.App/Services/CodeSearchService.cs` and `MemorySmith.App/Services/MemorySmithOptions.cs` with new controls: `QueryTimingTelemetryEnabled`, `QueryTimingLogInterval`, and `QueryTimingSlowThresholdMilliseconds`. Telemetry is disabled by default and only emits sampled debug logs unless a query crosses the configured slow threshold. Settings are surfaced in `MemorySmith.App/appsettings.json` under `MemorySmith:CodeSearch`.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Audit synthesis distinction: the redacted audit identifies durable raw query capture as a privacy issue. Existing timing telemetry is sampled and payload-free, but it does not by itself govern query text persisted in the event store; a focused redaction/hash task is being created.
